name: vllm-gcu on Enflame GCU
description: AccelMark runner for Enflame GCU accelerators using vllm-gcu (github.com/EnflameTechnology/vllm-gcu). Requires device=gcu. BF16/FP16; FP8 unsupported. GPTQ/AWQ/INT8; TP/PP/DP/EP via GCU interconnect.
notes: Not yet smoke-tested. Install vllm-gcu per the upstream repo (proprietary); requirements.txt adds benchmark deps only.
